name: Fallbrook
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Fallbrook, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Fallbrook, CA: the Community Center tree lighting, the Main Avenue Christmas Parade, Breakfast with Santa and a free museum open house.
lede: Fallbrook, the Friendly Village, does Christmas in small-town style: a tree lighting at the county's community center, a nighttime parade of lighted floats down Main Avenue, and Santa at a pancake breakfast and a history museum.
celebrates: The season starts at the Fallbrook Community Center on Heald Lane, where County Parks hosts a free Tree Lighting Festival with youth performances, local booths, food vendors and the lighting of the town tree. The next night the Fallbrook Chamber of Commerce sends its Christmas Parade down Main Avenue from Ammunition Road to Ivy Street, near the historic Mission Theater, with lighted floats, marching bands, dancers, classic cars and Santa at the end. The Chamber calls the whole season Christmas in the Village and asks downtown shops to decorate their windows to the parade theme. Later in December the Fallbrook Historical Society opens its museum for a Christmas Open House, and the community center serves Breakfast with Santa.
lastyear: In 2025 the 13th Annual Fallbrook Christmas Tree Lighting Festival took place on Friday, December 5, from 5 to 7:30 pm at the Fallbrook Community Center. Village News reported business vendors, local nonprofits, community outreach groups, food, entertainment and the lighting of the official town holiday tree. The next evening, Saturday, December 6, the Chamber of Commerce held the 44th Annual Fallbrook Christmas Parade on Main Avenue from 5 pm. County Parks closed the season with Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 20.
facts: The Fallbrook Christmas Parade is a nighttime event, run rain or shine, and 2026 marks its 45th year. The Chamber of Commerce takes up to 100 entries and picks a theme each year; for 2026 it is Americana Christmas, with retiring North County Fire Chief Keith McReynolds as Grand Marshal. At the Historical Society museum, a model train circles replicas of old Fallbrook buildings. Its builder, Geno Somacal, got his first train as a Christmas present and opened his basement layout to visitors free every December.
trains: Fallbrook once had its own railroad. The California Southern line ran up the Santa Margarita River to a Fallbrook Station in Temecula Canyon, and floods washed out track there in 1884 and 1891. The surviving Santa Fe Fallbrook Branch ran about 20 miles to Oceanside, carrying freight until a 1982 washout through Camp Pendleton, and its tracks were later removed. Today NCTD BREEZE route 306 links Fallbrook to the Vista Transit Center on the SPRINTER, and the Oceanside Transit Center serves the COASTER, SPRINTER, Amtrak Pacific Surfliner and Metrolink.
train_links: Big model railroad layouts in Balboa Park, a good next stop for kids who loved the Fallbrook museum's train.
Short rides on historic trains in Old Poway Park, with Christmas in the Park each December.
traditions: The Fallbrook Community Center lights the official town holiday tree on the first Friday evening of December, with free activities and youth performances.
The Chamber of Commerce's nighttime parade of lighted floats, bands and Santa rolls down Main Avenue on the first Saturday in December.
Downtown businesses decorate their windows to match each year's parade theme.
The Fallbrook Historical Society opens its Heritage Center for photos with Santa, museum tours, the model train, hot chocolate and cookies.
The Fallbrook Community Center serves a pancake breakfast with Santa on the Saturday before Christmas.
kidfact: The model train at the Fallbrook Historical Society started as a Christmas present. Its builder spent 1,500 hours making just one tiny building, the old Naples Hotel.
faq: When is the Fallbrook Christmas Parade?

The Fallbrook Chamber of Commerce holds its Christmas Parade on the first Saturday evening of December at 5 pm. It runs down Main Avenue from Ammunition Road to Ivy Street, near the historic Mission Theater, rain or shine. Expect lighted floats, marching bands, dancers, classic and specialty vehicles and, at the end, Santa Claus.
Where is the Fallbrook tree lighting?

At the Fallbrook Community Center, 341 Heald Lane, which is run by County of San Diego Parks and Recreation. The festival is free and family friendly, with youth program performances, booths from local organizations, food vendors and the lighting of the official town holiday tree. It usually falls on the evening before the Christmas Parade.
Where can kids meet Santa in Fallbrook?

Santa rides at the end of the Christmas Parade on Main Avenue. He also visits the Fallbrook Historical Society's Christmas Open House at the Heritage Center on South Hill Avenue, and the Fallbrook Community Center's Breakfast with Santa, a pancake breakfast with holiday entertainment and photos.

No. Fallbrook is an unincorporated community in north San Diego County, so there is no city hall tree. The County of San Diego runs the Fallbrook Community Center, which hosts the tree lighting, while the Fallbrook Chamber of Commerce organizes the Christmas Parade and the Christmas in the Village season.
How do you get to Fallbrook by train?

There is no train in Fallbrook today. The closest rail stops are the Vista Transit Center on the SPRINTER, which NCTD BREEZE route 306 links to Fallbrook via Mission Road, and the Oceanside Transit Center, which serves the COASTER, SPRINTER, Amtrak Pacific Surfliner and Metrolink.
